legal._readme: Change set A2 (docs/38 §7.3), approved by the operator on 26 September 2026 ('go with your recommendation'). Points 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 are the proposal's words. Point 3 (forum): 'the courts of Uganda' — the conservative form, no court named; jurisdiction.courts stays null until one is. Point 5 (data-protection law): none named; data_protection_law is null until a lawyer confirms the reference. Point 7 (fees): no Uganda figure is confirmed, so fees and transfer are null and the Terms state none — the Billing and Starlink-transfer sections point to the quotation and the invoice. Edit here, bump version, and every Uganda customer is asked once on the next sign-in. 5.18.94 (docs/67 §J; the operator, 12 Oct 2026: 'go with your recommendation'): identity without the UCC claim (the UCC letter of 4 Sep 2026 is a conditional no-objection, not a licence); terms_text and privacy_text replace section bodies with the website policies' wording (lib/LegalContent.php dnLegalSectionKeys); tos and privacy 1.2, dated the go-live day.

legal.sign_in: We sign you into the DishNet app by sending a six-digit code to your WhatsApp number or your e-mail address. When the code goes to WhatsApp, your phone number travels through Meta's WhatsApp Business infrastructure, subject to Meta's own privacy terms. We never ask for your WhatsApp password — only your phone number or e-mail address, so we can route the code to you.

terms_text.about: DishNet Africa Limited ("DishNet", "we", "us") is an independent IT solutions provider and Starlink installer registered in Uganda (Reg. No. 80046255496181), providing Starlink internet services to customers in Kampala and across Uganda. It is not an agent, partner or representative of Starlink or SpaceX, and it does not operate the Starlink satellite network. These terms cover this customer portal and related tools, and your use of our internet services. Our website terms and policies, listed at dishnetuganda.com/policies.html, also apply. A written agreement you sign with us, such as a Flex package agreement, comes first; where our website terms and these terms differ, the version that is better for you applies. By signing in or using any DishNet service, you agree to these terms.
terms_text.service: We provide the service with reasonable care and skill. Speeds are typical, not guaranteed: they depend on the Starlink network, which we do not operate, and on weather, obstructions such as trees and buildings, the number of people online at busy times, and your power supply. When the service is disrupted, we restore it as quickly as we reasonably can.
terms_text.billing: Monthly plans are billed in advance, one month at a time, and we remind you before each month is due. You can see your invoices and payments in this portal. If a month is not paid, the service pauses automatically at the end of the paid period and resumes when your payment is applied to your account, usually the same working day. There is no reconnection fee. If you dispute a bill, tell us: while we look into it, we do not pause your service over the amount you dispute, as long as you pay the rest. We accept the payment methods shown in this portal and on your invoice, and we will never ask for your mobile-money PIN or for a sign-in code we have sent you.
terms_text.acceptable_use: You agree not to use DishNet service for illegal activity, to send unsolicited bulk communication (spam), to attack or probe other networks without authorisation, or to host commercial services that violate Starlink's acceptable use policy. You agree not to resell DishNet connectivity without a written commercial agreement with us. If you break these rules, we first ask you to stop, unless the matter is urgent, harms others or the network, or the law requires immediate action; for serious or repeated breaches we may suspend or end the service. Our Acceptable Use and Fair Use Policy at dishnetuganda.com/acceptable-use.html also applies.
terms_text.equipment: Equipment you have bought and paid for in full belongs to you. Equipment we provide as part of a plan (for example a router) remains ours: you must not sell, lend, transfer or modify it. A kit on a Flex package follows the written agreement you sign for it. If our equipment is lost, stolen or damaged through misuse while it is with you, you pay the reasonable cost of repairing or replacing it, which we tell you first. Fair wear and tear, and damage we cause, are never charged.
terms_text.transfers: Starlink accounts managed on your behalf by DishNet may be transferred to you on request. Any minimum service period, transfer fee and processing time are confirmed to you in writing before a transfer. Transfers follow Starlink's own rules.
terms_text.termination: You may end a monthly plan at any time, by WhatsApp, e-mail or at our office, with no cancellation fee. It continues until the end of the month you have already paid for, and whole months paid in advance and not yet started are refunded. A Flex package, or another package with a minimum term, follows the written agreement you sign for it, which does not take away any right to cancel that the law gives you. We may end a plan whose bill is still unpaid while the service is paused, but only after telling you in writing and giving you a date to pay by. We may also suspend or end the service if you seriously or repeatedly break our Acceptable Use Policy or use the service unlawfully (we first ask you to stop, as the Acceptable use section says), where a court or authority lawfully requires it, or where Starlink makes the service impossible or unlawful to continue; in that last case we refund what you paid in advance for service we did not provide. Outstanding balances remain due, and equipment that belongs to us must be returned, except a kit on a Flex package, which follows its own agreement and the law: give us access to collect it, or return it to our office.
terms_text.liability: We are responsible for loss or damage you suffer as a foreseeable result of our breaking these terms or our negligence. Nothing in these terms limits our responsibility for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not allow us to limit. Otherwise, and as far as the law allows, we are not responsible for loss of business, profit, revenue or data, or for indirect loss. For loss caused by an interruption to the Starlink network or another network we do not operate, our responsibility is limited to the charges you paid for the affected service in the three months before the interruption, unless the loss results from our not providing the service with reasonable care and skill. If your service is down for more than 3 days in a row after you report a fault, and the cause is not your power supply, a new obstruction, damage, equipment moved by someone else or an unpaid bill, we credit your account with one day's share of your monthly charge for each full day it was down after your report. You do not pay for whole months in which the service could not be provided.
terms_text.changes: We may update these terms as our services or the law change. We tell you at least 30 days in advance about a change that is worse for you, and you may cancel before it takes effect with no charge for cancelling. When we make a material change, you are asked to accept the new version the next time you sign in. We keep every earlier version and send you a copy on request.
terms_text.jurisdiction: These terms are governed by the laws of Uganda, and the courts of Uganda can decide disputes about them. If something goes wrong, tell us so that we can put it right: our Complaints page at dishnetuganda.com/complaints.html explains how we handle complaints and where you can go if you are not satisfied, including the Uganda Communications Commission. That does not limit your right to use any complaint or dispute process the law gives you.

privacy_text.collect: Identity and contact details: your name, phone and WhatsApp number, e-mail address, and proof of identity where the law or service activation requires it. Location: your installation and delivery address, the location pin you send us, the location recorded when your installation was completed, and photos of the installed equipment. Account and service details: your plan, equipment serial numbers and identifiers, Starlink account and service details, installation and support history, your approval of installation jobs, and service data such as data used, connected devices (their names, MAC and IP addresses and link speed) and connection status. Payments: invoices, receipts, the mobile-money or bank transaction reference, and the number or account that paid. WiFi: your WiFi network name and password, which we keep when we set up your WiFi or manage your network, and when you change them or turn on the hotspot in this portal, so that we can show them to you and support you. Communications: messages, voice notes, photos and documents you send us, notes of calls and, where a call is recorded, the recording. Sign-in and technical data: the IP address and browser or device type recorded each time you sign in to this portal, and the time and IP address recorded when you accept our Terms and this Privacy Policy.
privacy_text.use: We use this information to answer your enquiries and prepare quotations; to deliver, install, activate and support your equipment and service; to bill you, record payments and keep the accounting and tax records the law requires; to send you service messages; to meet legal duties; and to keep our systems and customers safe and deal with complaints. Some replies on WhatsApp and in our website chat are written by an automated assistant; you can ask for a person at any time. Our billing system pauses a service automatically at the end of an unpaid period; you can ask a person to review it at any time. We send offers and news only if you have agreed, except follow-up messages about an enquiry you made and one message inviting you back after a service ends. Reply STOP on WhatsApp, or tell us any other way, and we stop sending them; you still receive service messages about your bills, payments, installation and faults. We do not use your information to target you with third-party advertising, and we do not sell it.
privacy_text.share: We share your information only as follows, and only what each one needs: Starlink (SpaceX), to activate and run Starlink service on your equipment, under Starlink's own privacy policy; payment providers and banks, such as Airtel Money, to process payments and refunds; the Uganda Revenue Authority, for the tax records the law requires; the Uganda Communications Commission and other authorities, where the law requires it; companies that provide services to us under contract, such as hosting, storage, back-up, e-mail and artificial-intelligence services; WhatsApp (Meta), which carries our WhatsApp messages with you; our technicians, delivery partners and authorised DishNet partners who deliver, install or support your service; and professional advisers, and a buyer of our business if it is ever sold, who must keep your information confidential. Some of these store or process information outside Uganda, which we allow only where the law permits. We do not share your information with advertisers or data brokers.
privacy_text.retention: Customer, billing, installation and support records: while you are a customer, and then for six years, the period within which a legal claim about them can usually be brought, or longer if tax law requires it. Enquiries that did not lead to an order: up to two years after our last contact. Call recordings, where a call is recorded: up to 12 months. When we no longer need information, we delete it, destroy it or remove the details that identify you.
privacy_text.rights: You can ask us whether we hold information about you, what it is and who it has been shared with, and for a copy of it; to correct information that is wrong or incomplete; to delete information we no longer need or should not hold; to stop using it in a way that causes you unwarranted damage or distress; to stop sending you marketing, at any time; and to withdraw a consent you have given. Contact {email} or WhatsApp {wa}. We may ask you to prove your identity, and we reply within 14 days. Some records we must keep by law, such as tax records, even if you ask us to delete them; if so, we tell you which and why. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Personal Data Protection Office (pdpo.go.ug).
privacy_text.contact: For any privacy question or request, e-mail {email} with "Privacy" in the subject, or WhatsApp {wa}.

integrations._readme: 5.18.74: the customer portal hands a customer over to the dishnet-data-report plugin's client view (the Usage links) with a token signed from this plugin's webhook_secret and crm_auth_token, which that plugin rebuilds and verifies. ON at the operator's decision (4 Oct 2026: 'usage link i want to keep'; 5.18.73 had switched it off because this install held neither value and every link ended in that plugin's 404). While either value is empty the portal does not mint a token and tells the customer the details are not available yet. Set them: php tools/set_config.php --key webhook_secret --generate (never shown) and Settings → UCRM Connection → Admin Auth Token. The explicit key portal_data_report_handoff=no hides the links.

quoting._readme: 5.18.99 (the operator, 20 Oct 2026: 'always company 1'): the uCRM organization every app customer is filed under and every app quotation is made for. A KYC customer is created in it; a lead client falls back to it when ucrm_lead_organization_id is unset; and no app quote is made for a client filed under any other organization — the salesperson is told to move the customer first. The explicit setting ucrm_quote_organization_id wins: php tools/set_config.php --key ucrm_quote_organization_id --value N, and 0 or off switches all of 5.18.99's Uganda behaviour off (5.18.98's behaviour). profiles/south-sudan.json has no such block.
